Johanna Faries is the current president of Blizzard Entertainment. She took the role in January 2024, replacing Mike Ybarra. Faries spent 12 years in the National Football League across multiple marketing and business departments. She later joined Activision, where she was the general manager of the Call of Duty franchise from 2018 to 2024. Faires was in talk with Blizzard by 2023 before taking the role in 2024. Her appointment was met with trepidation by some staff within Blizzard, given the company's contentious relationship with Activision.

The K'aresh Trust is the seventh Major Faction of . The trust is based out of Tazavesh after it has relocated to the remains of K'aresh. It consists of the broker cartels: Ba, Au, So, Xy, Zo, and Om, as well as ethereals from the Consortium. They are led by Ve'nari, who founded the trust and purchased Tazavesh to be used as a shipping port and recreation center for the revitalization of Project Eco-Dome.

The Kaja'Cola Machine is located at Camp Murroch in the Ringing Deeps. It dispenses the following cans at the cost of : Bluesberry Blast, Mangoro Madness, Orange O-pocalypse, and Oyster Outbreak. Dispensing drinks in an order spelling B-O-O-M, with the first letter of each drink, will additionally award a Goblin Mini Fridge.
Kala Clayhoof is a tauren located in the Crafter's Enclave in Dornogal. In the name of Artisan's Consortium, she directs adventurers with professions to fulfill crafting orders for local clientele.
Kaheti Warblade are looted from Kaheti Armaments in Rak-Zakaz in Azj-Kahet for Relics of War: Rak-Zakaz.

Kah'teht is a nerubian located by some waterfalls at the northern edge of the lake below Rak-Ahat in Azj-Kahet. They are originally from Azjol-Nerub, having been unsuccessfully sent by King Anub'arak to ask for Azj-Kahet's aid in the War of the Spider. Interacting with Kah'teht and completing their dialogue for the first time grants 85 reputation each with the General, the Vizier, and the Weaver, and is required for Khaz Algar Lore Hunter. __NOTOC__
Kal Smoulderbrow is an Arathi located in the Ruptured Lake in Azj-Kahet.
Kaheti All-Purpose Cleanser is provided as an objective for Tower Washing Simulator.
Kaheti Silk Hauler is a stagshell that walks back and forth between Rak-Zakaz and the Crawling Chasm in Azj-Kahet. It is escorted by two Kaheti Silk Guards.

The Kaldorei War Wolf is a wolf mount that was given out as a reward to viewers of eligible Twitch, YouTube, or TikTok streams who watched for at least 20 minutes from November 13-December 11 in 2024.

Kaja'Cola-braised Snapdragon Treat can be obtained by speaking with Blinky Greasefingers in Flotsam Shoal on the Siren Isle. After learning it, it becomes available for purchase from Zexel Fingersnap for , while still being available from Blinky. It changes the appearance of the Prismatic Snapdragon mount.
Kaldorei are projections that appear during Story Time in Tanaris. They appear in The Heroes of the Scarab Wall.
The Kaja'mite Stockpiles are found at Lucky Break Mines in Zuldazar. Monte Gazlowe wants them smashed in Crashing the Market.

Kaja Crabs are cave crabs located in and at the Lucky Break Mines at the Kaja'Coast in Zuldazar.
The Kaja-Carrying Razormaw is an enormous shark located off the Kaja'Coast in Zuldazar.
Kaja'fused Couplings drop from Venture Cratemovers in the Undermine. Pamsy wants two for The Thingamajig.
Kaigy's Clasp drops from Kaigy Maryla, Kharon, and the Dark Rider in the Karazhan Crypts

__NOTOC__ Kaja'Cola Carrier is a curio for Brann Bronzebeard during The War Within Season 2. The baseline version is found in low-tier delves, and higher-rank versions are found in higher-tier delves, all the way up to the Rank 4 version in Tier 8 delves. With the first placement of Brann's Cozy Campfire every delve, a Kaja'6-Pack can be found alongside it, containing a number of :Kaja'Cola cans. More can be found in Mislaid Curiosities, increasing with rank of the curio.

__NOTOC__ The Kaheti Slum Shark is an fish that can be caught in Khaz Algar. They are most commonly caught in Hallowfall and Azj-Kahet. In the former, they can be caught in pools of Blood in the Water, while in the latter they cluster in swarms of Slum Sharks. These fish are a key ingredient in the Feast of the Midnight Masquerade and are thus highly sought after by chefs across Khaz Algar.
